visualCharacteristics.imagePattern: optional poster image with play button

contentPattern: One row. A link to a YouTube (youtube.com/watch?v=, youtu.be, /embed/, /shorts/) or Vimeo URL; the link text becomes the iframe title. Optional picture in the same or another cell becomes a click-to-play poster. Without a poster the player loads lazily when the block nears the viewport. Any other URL renders as a plain link.
reuseGuidance: Use for standalone YouTube/Vimeo videos in page content (privacy-enhanced youtube-nocookie / Vimeo dnt).
